def open(self):
        """
        Fixes RDF validation issues. Zotero incorrectly uses ``rdf:resource`` as
        a child element for Attribute; ``rdf:resource`` should instead be used
        as an attribute of ``link:link``.
        """
        # Get all the Attribute elements
        attributes = self.root.findall('./rdf:Description/rdf:type/rdf:Description/rdf:Description/rdf:Description/rdf:Description', self.ns_map)

        # For each Attribute element, replace the child rdf:resource element
        # with an attribute
        for attribute in attributes:
            resource = attribute.find('rdf:resource', self.ns_map)
            if resource is not None:
                attribute.attrib['rdf:resource'] = resource.text
                attribute.remove(resource)

        # Remove all the empty Attribute elements
        for attribute in attributes:
            if not attribute.text:
                self.root.remove(attribute)
